corruptSays.line: The stash count is off. 2 stones missing. Nobody saw anything. Everybody suspects something.
The stash count is off. 2 stones missing. Nobody saw anything. Everybody suspects something.

◈ FLASHBACK — Michelle's Drawing
Kitchen table, burnt pancakes. You told her the sun needed holding, and she took you literally — drew you carrying it with both hands. She was six. The sky changed three weeks later.

◈ FLASHBACK — Unnamed photograph
There is a name you won't say out loud anymore. The photo doesn't need you to say it. Somebody you loved didn't make it to the clearing, and this is what's left of the proof they were here.

◈ FLASHBACK — Dispatcher's headset
You learned the voice — low, steady, unhurried. 'Panic is just information arriving too fast.' You hear it in your own voice now when it counts.

◈ FLASHBACK — Photo Album
Faces from before. Rong's wedding. Your dad asleep in the chair. The neighbor's kid with the missing tooth. The most valuable thing you own, and it weighs nothing.
Farid looks at the pantry, then at the Codex, then at you. "We’re going to make it." Haven will survive — because someone learned the land, and wrote it down. One less thing to fear.
Word reaches you, days late: Akbota stands accused over what happened to Ava. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.
Ava has been talking at the fires. Enough voices — tonight they call a moot. Akbota answers for what happened to Ava.
Ava calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
The moot turns to you. Your vote matters here — and everyone will remember it.
The moot doesn't wait forever. Two days of silence from the fire's edge — the count is taken without you.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hushpuppy: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (Two survived encounters — the fire has a theory.)
📓 Codex: Counter: Wound the lead — Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free.

They're named, every one: Fatima Petrov, Cole Diallo. Your move — ask them questions (up to three), call a MOOT on it, or turn them away at the edge of the firelight.
